about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/syntax: edits of the parser's derived forms that the package's tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/syntax; a unit that cannot afford the coverage pass applies each edit by hand and runs the killer. Seeded by wf10 batch-15 fix-r2 (L11b M1).

mutants.name: entry-clause-not-printed
mutants.rule: The formatter keeps a function type's entry prefix, so formatting keeps the tree.

mutants.name: pure-clause-not-printed
mutants.rule: The formatter keeps a parameter's pure clause, so formatting keeps the tree.

mutants.name: rc4b-format-drops-derive
mutants.rule: ergo fmt prints a derive as written (patterns.md, Derivation; the decided fixture derive.ergo formats to itself).

mutants.name: ex3-lent-modifier-unprinted
mutants.rule: The formatter keeps the lent mark before a constraint.

mutants.name: exm1-writes-takes-fn
mutants.rule: own on a function-typed parameter takes nothing, so a literal that writes only it still takes its expected type's clause (q168).

mutants.name: orp-product-drops
mutants.rule: A tuple or record pattern with alternatives in several elements means every combination of them (FK7a).

mutants.name: orp-field-unexpanded
mutants.rule: A record field's alternatives are expanded like a tuple element's (FK7a).

mutants.name: orp-group-unexpanded
mutants.rule: A parenthesised group's alternatives are expanded, under as too (FK7a).

mutants.name: orp-format-one-alt
mutants.rule: The formatter prints every alternative of an or-pattern (FK7a).

mutants.name: orp-covered-sibling-text
mutants.rule: An alternative covered by its sibling says so, not that an earlier case covers it (FK7a).

mutants.name: decode-refinement-shares-base
mutants.from: base := func() Expr { return opt[Expr](d, spec) }
mutants.to: base := func() Expr { _ = spec; return td.Spec }
mutants.rule: A refinement's parse function and law hold fresh copies of the base type, as the parser's again() does: no node stands twice in a file.

mutants.name: decode-written-dropped
mutants.rule: A case that holds an or-pattern keeps its patterns as written beside the expansion (orpattern.go).

mutants.name: decode-case-unexpanded
mutants.rule: A case's list is the expansion of its or-patterns, which the checker matches.

mutants.name: decode-machine-after-is-work
mutants.from:
case "work":
					x.Work = m.Value
				case "exit":
					x.Exit = m.Value
				default:
					x.After = m.Value
mutants.to:
case "exit":
					x.Exit = m.Value
				default:
					x.Work = m.Value
mutants.rule: A machine's entries are set by their names: after is the timers, work the work.

mutants.name: decode-import-go-named
mutants.rule: import go "path" is a Go package (ImportGo).

mutants.name: decode-doc-dropped
mutants.rule: A declaration's doc comment is the group the file lists, the same node (Doc and File.Comments share it).

mutants.name: decode-raw-string-keeps-cr
mutants.rule: A raw string's value has no carriage returns (scanner.go), so a CRLF file means what an LF file means.

mutants.name: decode-block-comment-keeps-cr
mutants.rule: A comment's text has no carriage returns (scanner.go).

mutants.name: decode-failure-line-column-swapped
mutants.rule: A failed parse is the Go parser's *Error, every field.

mutants.name: decode-bars-at-alt
mutants.rule: An or-pattern's Bars are the positions of its | tokens, which the formatter prints.

mutants.name: ctxf-decode-fails-dropped
mutants.from: Provides: opt[*ProvidesClause](d, d.fixed(r, 7, 3)), Fails: opt[*ErrorRow](d, d.fixed(r, 7, 4)),
mutants.rule: Layouts 4 and 5: a context declaration's word 4 is its fails row, decoded as the view reads it.

mutants.name: fixlines-class-dropped
mutants.rule: A fix's class is written with each edit, so a suggested fix never reads back as exact (FIX-DIALECT: ergo fix applies exact fixes only).

mutants.name: fixlines-edits-one
mutants.rule: Every fix line is one edit of the fix: none is dropped on the way to ergo fix.

mutants.name: ws0-gap-trims-space
mutants.from: out = append(out, tokenGap{text: src[at:int(t.pos)], next: ordinal})
mutants.to: out = append(out, tokenGap{text: strings.TrimSpace(src[at:int(t.pos)]), next: ordinal})
mutants.rule: The tokens with width and the gaps between them are the source byte for byte: no byte is outside the key but token positions.

mutants.name: decode-hashing-dropped
mutants.rule: The decoder reads a MapType's third item as its Hashing (CONSTRAINTS C5).

mutants.name: decode-tilde-dropped
mutants.rule: A `~T` term keeps its tilde: it admits every type whose underlying type is T.

mutants.name: decode-bare-term-dropped
mutants.rule: A bare type in an operation type's members is a term of its type set.

mutants.name: format-term-bar-dropped
mutants.rule: The formatter joins a type set's terms with `|`, so its text parses back to the same tree.

mutants.name: format-tilde-dropped
mutants.rule: The formatter prints a term's `~`.

mutants.name: format-hashing-dropped
mutants.rule: The formatter prints a Map's third type argument.

mutants.name: nou-defect-is-value
mutants.rule: NO-UNREACHABLE §3: die <expr> is a statement, never a value expression (S001 in value position).
